symptom: XHR dependency telemetry and trace headers disappeared from Vite/Rollup ESM bundles while fetch telemetry remained available.
checkpoint: Compare XHR and fetch instrumentation in the deployed bundle before treating missing dependencies as backend failure.
qualification: Reporter reproduction; open upstream issue, not a confirmed platform-wide defect.

symptom: An esbuild keepNames interaction caused telemetry initialization to fail silently.
checkpoint: Inspect SDK self-diagnostics and production bundle behavior when application events execute but telemetry is absent.
qualification: Reporter analysis with reproduction; open upstream issue.

symptom: Dependency ID validation rejected a plain span ID and disrupted W3C correlation.
checkpoint: Validate trace ID, span ID and parent relationships independently before blaming ingestion.
qualification: Open reporter issue; use as a correlation checkpoint, not confirmed root cause.

symptom: The offline channel did not resume transmission after an initially offline client became online.
checkpoint: Separate client buffering and recovery from service-side ingestion delay.
qualification: Closed completed issue; version applicability must be checked.

symptom: Request and response headers were absent from browser telemetry but present under Electron.
checkpoint: Account for browser security and SDK collection settings; never assume headers should be captured.
qualification: Closed not planned; weak evidence for a current defect and retained as a privacy/collection boundary.

symptom: Manual page-view tracking did not create the expected new trace context.
checkpoint: Compare route, page-view and dependency operation IDs before concluding navigation is correlated.
qualification: Closed completed issue; verify affected and fixed versions.

symptom: Telemetry from multiple micro frontends sharing one component could not be distinguished consistently without custom dimensions.
checkpoint: Confirm stable role and micro-frontend attribution before comparing error or latency rates.
qualification: Open feature request; describes an attribution limitation, not an outage.

symptom: A browser SDK interaction disrupted Angular local development after a framework update.
checkpoint: Reproduce with SDK disabled and compare development versus production bundles before changing Azure resources.
qualification: Closed completed compatibility issue; verify exact framework and SDK versions.

symptom: Diagnostic tooling did not behave as expected with the v3 SDK.
checkpoint: Record SDK major version and use its supported self-diagnostic path.
qualification: Closed completed bug report; version applicability is essential.

symptom: Request name and operation name appeared incompatible under a reported ASP.NET Core SDK combination.
checkpoint: Project both request name and operation name and compare telemetry initializer behavior.
qualification: Closed not planned; reporter observation is not a confirmed defect.

symptom: A .NET Framework Web API deployment reported no IIS telemetry.
checkpoint: Verify module loading, connection configuration, SDK diagnostics and ingestion reachability in that order.
qualification: Closed stale/not planned report; diagnostic checklist only.

symptom: Migrating to SDK v3 changed expectations for automatic App Service Profiler integration.
checkpoint: Separate profiler configuration from trace and metric export after an SDK migration.
qualification: Open documentation issue; indicates migration ambiguity rather than confirmed runtime failure.

symptom: SDK initialization failed to match a Statsbeat endpoint.
checkpoint: Inspect cloud, ingestion endpoint and sovereign-region configuration without exposing the connection string.
qualification: Closed completed issue; verify SDK version and cloud endpoint.

symptom: Exception telemetry constructed from detail objects lost type and property fidelity.
checkpoint: Compare the emitted exception envelope with the source exception before blaming KQL projection.
qualification: Closed stale/not planned; unconfirmed report retained as a serialization checkpoint.

symptom: Availability telemetry under v3 reportedly lost trace and span information.
checkpoint: Verify availability operation and parent IDs across the SDK migration boundary.
qualification: Open reporter issue; correlation behavior requires local reproduction.

symptom: An operator could not find the prior adaptive-sampling setting after moving to v3.
checkpoint: Identify the active instrumentation stack before interpreting itemCount or changing sampling.
qualification: Closed completed migration question; configuration differs by SDK generation.

symptom: Metric tracking produced no customMetrics while trace tracking succeeded after a v3 migration.
checkpoint: Test each telemetry signal separately and verify metric aggregation/export semantics.
qualification: Closed with documentation outcome; do not classify automatically as service ingestion failure.

symptom: A v3 integration reported traces missing when used with Serilog.
checkpoint: Isolate logger provider routing from exporter health by emitting a direct test trace.
qualification: Closed completed bug report; confirm logging integration and affected versions.
